what: A listing on the buy side (spec/pages.md §6.14): its photos, its price delivered against what the same one sold for, the seller and who covers the sale, and the acts: Open on site, Offer (three amounts and Something else), Watch. An offer is a hand-off.
frame: Who: the hunter, from a match alert or a search row, deciding in a minute whether to buy, offer or wait.
Came to do: judge the photos and the price, then buy on the site or make an offer.
Where a mistake costs most: an offer sent at the wrong amount (it binds on eBay once accepted), and a pickup with no site cover read as covered.
Ways out (spec/ways-out.md §6.12): Open on site from any listing; offers ask every time; Not my size teaches the want; Ask the seller; I bought it.
In the loop: when the agent has an offer ready, its amount is a dotted guess and the foot says exactly what it sends; nothing goes until the tap.
decisions: Photos first, swiped, with dots, as every marketplace app opens a listing; one photo keeps the dot row so every listing is the same height.
The price is the peak amount: delivered, because that is what the person pays (M26), with the asking price in the line under it.
Where the price sits is a bar with the range in words under it (copy.md: show, then say the range the way a friend would).
The read of the price is words with an icon, not a tag: no state color means fair (round-2 call).
Open on site is the page's one act at the foot: buying happens on the site, and we never take payment (spec buy.md step 7).
When the agent has an offer ready, the foot becomes that offer ('Send a $65 offer') and Open on site moves up beside Watch: one black button per view.
The offer picker is a sheet of three whole-dollar amounts under the asking price, then Something else, with the one money sentence: 'If they accept, you pay on the site.'
Watch is done at once with Undo: it can be undone where it happened.
The rest (Ask the seller, Not my size, I bought it) sit under More in the nav, as iOS puts a page's other acts.
Who covers the sale is said per site from the trust note (research/sold/nate/trust-returns-disputes.md §9); a pickup says plainly that nothing covers it.
A visitor sees everything; Offer and Watch take them to sign in at that moment.
A listing that is gone shows the gone page, with nothing that would act on it (break-ui: a gone match still offered Offer).
An offer over the asking price can't be sent: the disabled button says 'Over their price of $64' (break-ui: Something else took $1,000,000).
Loading is the page's skeleton, failed says what did not load with Retry, and offline keeps the last copy under 'Waiting for signal' (app/src/buy/states.tsx), the same on every buy page.

states.shows: No site cover on a pickup. Pay when you see it.
